notes.title: Dimenders Coming Back
notes.content:
[h3]Today, [b]Dimenders [/b]leaves Early Access and returns with a major update![/h3]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]

A lot has changed since the last update, and here's a non-exhaustive list:

[list]
[*] A new possible ending
[*] Improved voice chat
[*] New features
[*] New creatures 
[*] And much more to explore
[/list]

There are also new Steam achievements.

[h2] Enjoy the game! [/h2]

I really hope you enjoy this update as much as i enjoyed working on it. Dive into the new content and explore all the changes and additions! I can’t wait to hear what you think. Have fun!

[b]Please note![/b] 
If you're playing in multiplayer and in the very first level (the beginning), some objects may not be displayed correctly. Restart the level to fix the problem.
I apologize for this inconvenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344256/d386181c7877ef1d566f9d9252edc39caeba4aa4.png[/img]

notes.title: Next Update Information #2
notes.content:
Dimenders next major update is currently in closed beta testing.

With this update, the game will officially leave Early Access.

I don't have a precise release date yet, but if all goes well, it should be ready in November.

notes.title: Next Update Information
notes.content:
I'm currently working on a major update that includes features such as:

- New items
- New monsters
- New levels
- New ending
- Rework of all existing levels
- Improve storyline
- Improve voice chat

And much more! Expected to be released in the coming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344256/a8df0ab5606dee132690c579b2df83a0e606cb74.png[/img]
